##### Project general facts

Celeste Heights is a refined mid-rise development where architecture is shaped by rhythm, balance, and a sense of quiet elevation. Rising across eight residential floors with podium and rooftop levels, the project presents a curated collection of one- to three-bedroom residences and premium apartments. The design is defined by alternating floor layouts that create variation and individuality, ensuring each home feels distinct while maintaining a cohesive architectural identity. Clean lines, thoughtful proportions, and elevated vantage points come together to create a calm, contemporary living environment above the city.

The lifestyle at Celeste Heights is centered around comfort, focus, and understated luxury. Rooftop amenity spaces offer open views and a serene atmosphere designed for relaxation, while carefully curated communal areas support both social interaction and personal retreat. A refined co-working lounge introduces a functional yet elegant environment for productivity, seamlessly blending work and leisure within the same setting. Every shared space is designed with intention, creating a balanced rhythm between activity and stillness.

Interiors reflect an intuitive approach to modern living, combining refined finishes with smart home integration to enhance everyday comfort. Clean, uncluttered design language continues into the kitchens, which are equipped with high-end appliances and crafted to feel both functional and serene. Residences are delivered unfurnished, offering flexibility for personalization while maintaining a strong foundation of quality materials and sophisticated detailing throughout.

##### Location description and benefits

Al Furjan is a residential community situated in close proximity to Dubai Marina, Jumeirah Beach Residence (JBR), and other popular areas in Dubai. It covers an area of approximately 560 hectares and consists of both villas and apartment buildings, offering a diverse range of housing options for residents.

The community is known for its well-planned infrastructure and thoughtfully designed properties. It features a mix of architectural styles, including Arabic, Mediterranean, and contemporary designs, creating a visually appealing and diverse atmosphere.

In terms of amenities, Al Furjan offers a range of facilities to enhance the quality of life for its residents. These include landscaped parks, playgrounds, fitness centers, swimming pools, sports courts, and cycling and jogging tracks. There are also retail centers within the community that provide convenient access to shopping, dining, and other essential services.
